endorsements.quote: For successful implementation, AI-mediated teledentistry should be introduced through pragmatic, stepwise models that align with existing clinical pathways rather than functioning as stand-alone technologies.

Initial deployment may focus on high-yield applications such as postoperative follow-up, preventive monitoring in dependent older adults, triage of urgent complaints, and caregiver-supported oral hygiene supervision.
Training of dental teams and caregivers is equally important to ensure appropriate image capture, interpretation of automated prompts, and escalation of urgent findings.

To promote effective adoption, AI literacy should also be incorporated into implementation strategies through caregiver training, demonstration-based learning, simplified educational materials, voice-guided instructions, and repeated support within home care or nursing home settings.

Therefore, informed consent procedures should be simple, transparent, and adapted to the cognitive and digital literacy levels of the target population, with explicit explanations of data privacy, user rights, withdrawal options, and human oversight.

unlisted_practices: Include continuous validation, audit trails, and error-reporting mechanisms in risk management for AI-mediated teledentistry.
Provide clinician review of AI-generated recommendations in AI-mediated teledentistry.
Establish clear escalation protocols when submitted data quality is insufficient or urgent findings are suspected.
Position AI-mediated teledentistry within a hybrid care model in which remote assessment complements rather than replaces direct clinical examination.
Provide simple multilingual interfaces, voice-assisted navigation, and smartphone or tablet compatibility for AI-mediated teledentistry.
Integrate AI-mediated teledentistry with electronic health records or referral systems where available.
Run pilot programs in community services, nursing homes, and domiciliary dental networks to refine workflows, evaluate cost-effectiveness, and generate real-world evidence before scale-up.

screen.reason: This is a perspective article discussing the conceptual shift toward using AI as an intelligent intermediary in teledentistry for elderly populations.
